ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Day Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial records of day care centers in Minnesota, tracing the flow of money and identifying potential shell companies or other fraudulent activity
questions: How much money has been stolen through day care fraud in Minnesota?
What are the connections between the day care centers and other businesses or individuals?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial records of these day care centers, we may be able to identify a larger pattern of fraudulent activity and uncover the individuals or organizations behind it.
